details: Filtered strictly to is_batter_ball_faced == True (179,590 deliveries). Wides excluded; no-balls faced retained.
Evaluated strictly on batter_runs. Byes, leg-byes, and wides carry zero weight in batter ledger.
Evaluated strictly on is_striker_dismissed. Non-striker run outs do not penalize striker.
Evaluated on bowler_runs_conceded. Byes and leg-byes are excluded; wide and no-ball runs included.
Evaluated strictly on is_bowler_wicket (bowled, caught, lbw, stumped, hit wicket). Run outs excluded.
Evaluated strictly on legal balls quota: sum(w_t * is_legal_ball). Complies with Step 6.2 Approach B.
Wides and no-balls debit bowler runs conceded in numerator without advancing the legal-ball denominator.
Step 7.2.1 Condition 1 strictly applied: lambda_eff = min(lambda_wkt, runs_required) for W_rem >= 2.
Step 7.2.1 Condition 2 strictly applied: lambda_eff = lambda_wkt (uncapped) for W_rem == 1.
Step 7.2.1 Condition 3 strictly applied: IPL deliveries use IPL DLS parameters; T20I use T20I parameters.
Pre-delivery pressure, score_before, and W_rem use strictly pre-delivery state. No future match leakage.
No player IDs or individual performance metrics enter situational baselines or pressure calculations.
